crossRefs.note: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!
“They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood. They have grown strong in the land, but not for truth; for they…
But I will bring your little ones that you said should be captured or killed in, and they shall know the land which you…
But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: Why does Yahweh bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”
translations.bsb: Why is the LORD bringing us into this land to fall by the sword? Our wives and children will become plunder. Would it not be better for us to go back to Egypt?”
translations.kjv: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
translations.asv: And wherefore doth Jehovah bring us unto this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be a prey: were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
